import React, { useState } from "react"; import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom"; import { Screen } from "../components/common/UI"; import { useStore } from "../context/StoreContext"; import "../styles/PaymentCheckout.css"; export default function PaymentCheckout() { const navigate = useNavigate(); const [searchParams] = useSearchParams(); const { getOrder, currentOrder } = useStore(); const [country, setCountry] = useState("Australia"); const orderId = searchParams.get("orderId"); const order = getOrder(orderId) || currentOrder; const merchantName = order?.merchant?.business_name || order?.shop || "the merchant"; const amountKes = order?.total?.kes || order?.total; const handlePay = (event) => { event.preventDefault(); navigate(`/payment/success?orderId=${order?._id || orderId}`); }; return (
